name: How do I choose the right contractor for my residential interior remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my residential interior remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selecting the right professional requires looking beyond the bottom-line estimate to assess hands-on involvement, verified credentials, and real craft specialization. Look for a licensed and insured contractor who maintains an active Better Business Bureau accreditation and carries verifiable references for custom tile, trim, and structural framing. It is wise to ask who will physically supervise the jobsite each day; small, owner-operated firms offer direct accountability because the business owner is on-site guiding daily work rather than delegating communication to revolving project managers. Always ensure your contract outlines clear scope details, material specifications, and staged payment schedules.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check for BBB accreditation, verified local references, and insurance, and choose an owner-operated contractor who provides on-site supervision and clear, detailed estimates.
